style_notes: House style: flat vector, night-to-day palette, Mote as guide. Diagrams in paper-white line art with colour only where it carries meaning (blue = scattered light).

scenes.concept: Daytime sky; Mote looks up; title question lands on 'blue'.
scenes.motion: Sun pops, clouds drift, title fades up, 'blue' word punches.

scenes.concept: Sunbeam meets air molecules; blue scatters in all directions, red continues straight.
scenes.visual_metaphor: molecules as tiny pinballs that bounce blue light sideways
scenes.motion: Beam draws on; on 'scattered' blue rays burst outward with stagger, then until the cut packets of light keep streaming from the sun into the molecules: blue ones scatter out along every ray, red ones carry on straight.

scenes.concept: The payoff number: blue scatters ~5.9× more than red; Mote is delighted.
scenes.motion: Counter runs up on 'six'; chips slide in; Mote pops and blinks.
